title: Add Cloudflare to Flask Hosting Platforms docs?
author: hoodmane
body_preview: Cloudflare workers supports deploying Flask applications. We have the following short guide for deploying Flask workers: https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/languages/python/packages/flask/  Could we add a link to this page to the "Hosting Platforms" section of the docs?

author: davidism
body_preview: Already deprecated `cls` arguments to everything, but missed the ones named `response` instead.

title: `Response.location` and `content_location` should use `iri_to_uri`
author: davidism
body_preview: They currently store strings, then call `iri_to_uri` in `to_wsgi_headers`. And that's only done for WSGI, so sans-IO/ASGI doesn't get it. Instead, they should always be stored as URIs, and accessed as IRIs.

title: reorder `MultiDict` for better type checking
author: davidism
body_preview: The current hierarchy is `dict` < `MultiDict` < `ImmutableMultiDict`, where the immutable class overrides mutable methods to raise errors. This is unhelpful to type checkers, which need to be additive; `Mapping` < `MutableMapping` < `dict`. It also "breaks" if a new mutable method is added to `dict`, such as `__ior__`. title: pass `request` instead of `environ` where possible
author: davidism
body_preview: `Request` has a bunch of header properties that cache the result of parsing. Werkzeug has a bunch of individual functions that work on `environ`, meaning everything needs to be re-parsed everywhere. Some functions (but not consistently) accept a `Request` or `environ`, but then pick `request.environ`, so they're not actually benefiting.
